hashints_compute_hash: compute a hash of a list of integers and return a non-negative integer less than 2**31-1
hashints_use_xxhash: use xxhash to compute a 32-bit digest of a numpy uint32 array of integers
hashints_hash_int_list: hash a list of integers using xxhash and return a masked non-negative result
review_hashints: review the hashints function that computes an xxHash-32 digest of an integer list
test_hashints: test the hashints function with a list of integers and verify the returned non-negative hash value
